services_intro: Every service has a fixed scope, a written price and a clear deliverable, so you always know what you are getting before you commit.

about_lead: We are a small team helping local businesses deliver clear, dependable service at fair prices.
about_who_we_are: We work with professionals, freelancers and small businesses in the area. You always talk to the same person, the one who does the work, with no salespeople or middlemen in between. We explain every step in plain language so you know what is being done and why.
about_mission: Our mission is to give local businesses straightforward service they can rely on, with the scope and the price agreed in writing before we start. We would rather do a few things well than promise results that do not depend on us.
how_1_description: We review your situation before we act.
how_4_description: You talk to the person who does the work.
principle_2: We do not promise results we cannot control.
principle_4: We never buy or invent reviews.
about_zone_description: We work with businesses in {{coverage_area}}. Knowing the local area helps us understand what your nearby customers really need and plan the work around it.
about_remote_description: Outside that area we work remotely only. Meetings and deliveries happen by email, WhatsApp or video call, so distance changes neither the price nor the timeline of the service.
contact_lead: Write to us and we will reply within one business day. Tell us what kind of business you have, what you need help with and any relevant links or details.
contact_action_description: Not sure where to start? Begin with our free initial consultation.
contact_location_description: Based in the area, with support available remotely.
faq_1_answer: It is the first of the services we offer. Each service has its own page with a written scope, a fixed price and a clear deliverable, so you can see exactly what is included.
faq_3_answer: We offer a small set of services for local businesses, from one-off jobs to optional monthly care. You can see every service, with its scope and price, on the services page.
faq_4_answer: Prices depend on the service and are always published and agreed in writing before we start. The pricing page lists every amount, and anything extra is quoted and approved first.
faq_5_answer: Start with the featured action: a free first conversation in which we look at your situation and tell you which service, if any, makes sense for you.
faq_8_answer: No. One-off services are paid once, and monthly services can be cancelled at any time with a short notice before the next invoice.
faq_9_answer: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee specific results. What we do guarantee is a clear written scope, a fixed price and regular communication, so you always know where things stand.
faq_12_answer: It depends on the service and on your starting point. One-off services usually finish within a few weeks, and we give you an estimate in writing before we begin.
faq_15_answer: Yes. Whatever we deliver is yours from the first day, and we explain how to access and manage it.
